# UYWNIX — Full Company Profile

## Who we are
UYWNIX (uywnix.com) is an AI automation company headquartered in India, serving businesses worldwide in London, New York, Dubai, Singapore, Toronto, Sydney, and 50+ cities. We help small teams operate like large enterprises with custom AI agents, chatbots, and automated workflows.

## Products and Services

### AI Sales Agents
Qualify leads, follow up automatically, and book meetings 24/7 across web, email, and WhatsApp. Starts at $999/month.

### AI Voice Employees
Phone agents that answer calls, qualify callers, and book appointments in a natural voice. Available in English, Hindi, Arabic, and more.

### AI Chatbots & Support Agents
Instant customer support, product guidance, and FAQ handling trained on your business data.

### Workflow Automation
Connect CRM, email, WhatsApp, and internal tools into one automated pipeline. No-code friendly, custom-built when needed.

### Custom AI Model Fine-Tuning
We train and fine-tune custom AI models on your own data — for small companies and enterprises — including secure on-premise deployment.

### Software Development & Prototypes
Landing pages ship in 7–10 days; clickable prototypes in days; full MVP builds in 3–6 weeks. AI-augmented engineering keeps builds fast.

## Our Product: UYWNI
UYWNI (uywni.com) is an all-in-one social platform: feed, end-to-end encrypted chat, HD video calls, and a freelance marketplace. Live on the App Store and Google Play with 5,000+ organic users. AI roadmap: a personalized AI assistant integrated across chat, video, and audio calls, plus real-time multilingual call translation powered by GPU-accelerated inference.

## Pricing
- AI Sales Agent: $999/month (managed, CRM integration, 1,000 leads/month)
- Growth: $2,499/month (three AI agents, text and voice, custom workflows, priority support)
- Websites: from $499 (launch offer)
- Custom model training: custom quote
